description: Analyst-derived conditional distribution of identifiable diary events, not the complete bank-ledger distribution or an official Federal Reserve four-kind statistic.
estimator: Ratio of event counts weighted by ind_weight, restricted to 5735 nationally weighted respondents with complete three-day diaries; full fieldwork, not a strict October-only estimate.

mapping.purchase: payment=1, pi in 3/4, known merch other than financial-services code 15 or P2P code 16
mapping.transfer: payment=1 and pi=11; or payment=0 with chktransferaccount in 1..6 in chktransfer module, or chkdepfunds in 6/8 in chkdep module
mapping.deposit: payment=0 with chkdepfunds in 1/2/4/5/7 in chkdep module, or cashdepaccount in 1/2 in cashdep module
mapping.withdrawal: payment=0 with cashgetsource in 1/2/5 in cashget module

limitations: Exclude missing/nonpositive amounts, unmatched/incomplete/non-national respondents and ambiguous events; retain published rows, without deduplicating nonunique nominal transaction keys.
Cash payments are not withdrawals. ACH and mobile-app payments are not exclusively transfers.
Reported transfer events are not linked economic transfers or paired ledger entries.
No amount, merchant, timestamp, settlement, subscription or fraud distribution is inferred or changed by this profile.
